name: StreamingUnity Hermes
description: Movies and TV series from streamingunity.win (English interface): search, full season and episode lists, HLS playback with per-language audio tracks and subtitle tracks (Hermes test variant).
changelog: Sub/Dub routing fix: stream pairs now carry 'sub'/'dub' labels (module contract) and a Sub request always flips the playlist's default audio to the original track, even when the guest embed points at the Italian dub
TV Shows and Movies grids now page through the source's own infinite-scroll JSON endpoint (60 per source page, type-filtered) - previously they stopped after the first 30 items
Discovery home: Trending hero row now first; the Top-10 row reserves its ten ranked items before the hero so both rows keep full counts (beta.2 had Top 10 above Trending)
Repository import repair in beta.2: community test identity SP-VID-9004-STREAMINGUNITY-HERMES-TEST added (beta.1 shipped development identity 0, which Player rejects during repository install)
